test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 30 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: 'X' gas is produced during the electrolysis of brine. Then, 'X' gas is used in dry slaked lime to produce CaOCl₂. What is 'X'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chlorine**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Chlorine (Cl)**

 
 
• Atomic Number: 17
 
• Atomic Mass: 35.45 u
 
• Group: 17 (Halogens)
 
• Period: 3
 
• Properties:
 
• A greenish-yellow gas at room temperature.
 
• Highly reactive and a strong oxidizing agent.
 
• Used in water disinfection, production of PVC, and various other industrial processes.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Nitrogen (N)**

 
 
• Atomic Number: 7
 
• Atomic Mass: 14.01 u
 
• Group: 15 (Pnictogens)
 
• Period: 2
 
• Properties:
 
• Colorless, odorless, and tasteless gas.
 
• Essential component of the Earth's atmosphere (78%).
 
• Crucial for the growth of plants and animals.
 
• Used in the production of fertilizers, explosives, and other industrial chemicals.
 
 
 
• **Hydrogen (H)**
 
 
• Atomic Number: 1
 
• Atomic Mass: 1.008 u
 
• Group: 1 (Alkali Metals)
 
• Period: 1
 
• Properties:
 
• The lightest element.
 
• Colorless, odorless, and tasteless gas.
 
• Highly flammable.
 
• Essential component of water and most organic compounds.
 
• Used as a fuel source and in various industrial processes.
 
 
 
• **Sulfur (S)**
 
 
• Atomic Number: 16
 
• Atomic Mass: 32.07 u
 
• Group: 16 (Chalcogens)
 
• Period: 3
 
• Properties:
 
• Yellow, crystalline solid at room temperature.
 
• Found in various minerals, including pyrite (fool's gold).
 
• Used in the production of sulfuric acid, vulcanization of rubber, and other industrial applications.
